headlines.title: Trump bans CNN, MS NOW, Politico from White House
headlines.description: President Trump banned CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House for what he called one-sided coverage. NBC News’ Kelly O’Donnell reports.

headlines.title: What might an AI doomsday look like? Experts have given it some thought
headlines.description: A small but dedicated group of AI experts has been warning for years that increasingly powerful AI systems could cause catastrophic damage or even lead to human extinction.

headlines.title: Google says its AI model gained unauthorized access to three outside systems
headlines.description: Google on Friday disclosed the first known instance of its artificial intelligence software, Gemini, carrying out an undirected computer hack, weeks after similar disclosures by AI firms Anthropic and OpenAI raised security alarms about AI models going beyond the instructions of their human creators.

headlines.title: Hackers breached OpenAI, adding to fever pitch of security and safety concerns
headlines.description: A small group of cybersecurity researchers said Sunday that they broke into OpenAI earlier this year, an announcement that has added a new element of alarm around AI security and safety.

headlines.title: A rapper gets the boot, and the Fed raises interest rates: The news quiz
headlines.description: The Kennedy Center votes to close, Merriam-Webster adds new words, and House lawmakers leave early.

headlines.title: The first mRNA flu shot is now available. Here’s who can get it.
headlines.description: People looking to get their annual flu shot this fall may find a new option alongside the usual vaccines: an mRNA flu shot. Not everyone is eligible, however.

headlines.title: Which party will win on affordability?
headlines.description: In the second episode of Here’s the Scoop, Election Edition, how Democrats and Republicans are owning – or ignoring – the affordability crisis.

headlines.title: Texas college quarterback apologizes for comments about violent AI video
headlines.description: Texas Longhorns quarterback Arch Manning apologized for referencing an AI video showing his coach slapping ESPN sideline reporter Holly Rowe. “In my press conference yesterday, I made an insensitive comment about an AI video. There is nothing funny about it,” Manning wrote.

headlines.title: FBI warned immigration authorities about fake tradwife dating profiles
headlines.description: An FBI memo said that a small group of women were posing with a “traditional wife” esthetic as a tactic to lure immigration authorities.

headlines.title: CNN, Politico and MS NOW denied White House access after Trump announces ban
headlines.description: Journalists from MS NOW, CNN and Politico were denied access to the White House grounds Saturday, a day after President Donald Trump said on social media that he had banned the news outlets over what he called their “constant ‘reporting’ FAKE NEWS.”

headlines.title: Is it too early to panic in the NFL? These teams don’t want to find out
headlines.description: Sixteen NFL teams, including some with big playoff aspirations like the Dallas Cowboys and Los Angeles Rams, are trying to avoid falling to 0-2.
